howItWorks.title: How this demo audits
howItWorks.intro: This is exactly what the demo engine does with each invoice. Everything else is configured in your project.

s1.title: PDF reading
s1.desc: The server extracts the PDF text. Scanned PDFs (images) are not read in this demo.

s2.title: AI extraction
s2.desc: The procedures table is read with patterns (code, description, quantity and amounts). An OpenAI language model (GPT-4o mini) extracts the invoice number, patient, ICD-10 diagnosis and authorization.

s3.title: Fee schedule and rules
s3.desc: Each CUPS code is compared against the sample fee schedule. If the billed amount exceeds the tariff, a denial for the difference is proposed.

s4.title: Model proposal
s4.desc: A second OpenAI model (GPT-4o) reviews the data and drafts a proposal: amount to pay, rationale and whether human review is needed.

s5.title: Auditor decision
s5.desc: You confirm, adjust or discard each denial with a note. The server recalculates the totals and you can download the report as CSV or PDF.

howItWorks.tariffNote: Sample codes and amounts used by the demo engine. They do not correspond to any real contract or fee schedule manual.

rules.r1: Billed amount above the sample tariff: denial for the difference times the quantity (rule 202, tariff difference).
rules.r2: Code not in the sample fee schedule: the engine proposes denying 30% of the amount. It is a provisional demo rule; in your project it is replaced by your contract's tariffs.
rules.r3: Rule codes (such as 202) are internal to the demo; in your project they are mapped to Colombia's current Single Manual of Returns, Denials and Responses.

howItWorks.notIncludedTitle: What this demo does not do (built in your project)

notIncluded.n1: Read RIPS files (JSON or Excel) and cross-check them with the PDF.
notIncluded.n2: Validate authorizations with the payer (validity and quantities).
notIncluded.n3: Review clinical consistency between diagnosis and procedure, and medications.
notIncluded.n5: Take the provider and payer from the PDF: the demo uses a sample provider and payer.
notIncluded.n6: Apply per-payer contracts and official catalogs (CUPS, ICD-10) with their version.
notIncluded.n8: Keep data separate per client: this demo space is shared.

howItWorks.projectNote: In your project we connect your contracts and fee schedules, the official catalogs and your rules, and process RIPS and supporting documents.
